historical_summaries.summary: Engineering team discussed H-Bridge Driver (HB-900) voltage tolerance specifications. Consensus reached on 5V ±10% operating range. Sarah from avionics confirmed this meets actuator control requirements. Part number finalized as HB-900-REV3.

TechSupply Corp experienced customs delay on previous order (capacitor shipment CAP-400 series). Delay was 10 days due to incomplete export documentation. Team noted to request advance shipping notices for future orders. Vendor rated 3.5/5 for reliability.

Q3 Integration Test originally scheduled for 2023-09-30 was moved to 2023-10-15 due to Lab 3 availability conflict. QA team was testing battery systems during the original window. All stakeholders (avionics, mechanical, supply-chain) confirmed Oct 15 works.

TVC Actuator (ACTUATOR_TVC_001) bench testing completed successfully. Control signal response time measured at 12ms (within spec). Driver interface verified compatible with HB-900 pinout. Mechanical team confirmed mounting bracket alignment.

Q4 Final Assembly milestone planning meeting. Target date confirmed as Nov 1, 2023. Budget allocated: $500k. Critical path items identified: Integration Test completion, procurement of secondary components, QA sign-off. Risk assessment: moderate supply chain uncertainty.
